The fix adds `v.major == base.major` to the caret condition, which correctly enforces that caret ranges match `>=base` but `<major+1.0.0` (i.e., `^1.2.3` matches `>=1.2.3 <2.0.0`).

The tilde (`~`) logic was already correct (`>=base` and same major and minor, i.e., `~1.2.3` matches `>=1.2.3 <1.3.0`).
